description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Library building points identify branches of the county and Tacoma public-library systems. The native layer exposes point geometry and named attributes, including ZIPCODE, BRANCHID, BRANCH, STREET, CITY, SOURCE. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. These facility locations provide no opening hours, service demand or capacity measurements. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
